capabilities: Synchronise heading folds between the core Outline and the active document
Add Outline collapse arrows to headings that have body text but no subheadings
Remember and restore each note's heading folds across sessions
Preserve nested, list, and frontmatter folds when toggling headings
Reapply document fold state to the Outline via a command
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.4+, the core Outline plugin, and Editor fold-heading enabled; desktop verified only on macOS, mobile untested. The README notes synchronisation may break after Obsidian updates or with Outline-replacement plugins, since Obsidian publishes no fold API. No settings; manual installation only.
intentEvidence: Keep heading folds in Obsidian's core Outline and the active Markdown document in sync.
problem: In Obsidian, folding a heading in the core Outline does not fold it in the editor or vice versa, so the two views drift out of sync.
summary: Keeps heading fold state synchronised between Obsidian's core Outline view and the active Markdown document in either direction.
